dataset_spec.name: uci_arrhythmia
dataset_spec.description: UCI Cardiac Arrhythmia (Bilkent; 429 observations after excluding rhythm classes with n<10; 23 rows dropped). 279 predictors: demographics, global interval/axis measurements and, for each of the 12 standard leads, wave widths, deflection counts, morphology flags, wave amplitudes and QRS/QRST areas. 8 retained rhythm classes.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult referred for a standard resting 12-lead electrocardiogram. The observations are the automatically measured global intervals, frontal-plane axes and heart rate, followed by, for each of the twelve leads (DI, DII, DIII, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1-V6), the wave widths, number of intrinsic deflections, wave-morphology flags, wave amplitudes and QRS/QRST areas.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Resting 12-lead ECG measurements (widths in ms; amplitudes in tenths of a millivolt; 0 means the wave is absent in that lead):

pr_interval.text_label: Average P-R interval (onset of P to onset of Q)

qt_interval.text_label: Average Q-T interval (onset of Q to offset of T)

qrs_angle.text_label: QRS axis in the frontal plane

t_angle.text_label: T-wave axis in the frontal plane

p_angle.text_label: P-wave axis in the frontal plane

qrst_angle.text_label: QRST axis in the frontal plane

j_angle.text_label: J-point axis in the frontal plane
